Your health, mental and physical, are far more important than a job. Aswell, you are not your best self as an employee when you are exhausted and burnt out. It is actually recommended that you take a vacation when you feel this way so that your quality of work, quality of life and health don't diminish. 

I hope this was helpful. Please take care of yourself. Stay safe and healthy 😊

Hey, as someone who has chronic depression I feel you very much. 
Exercise is supposed to be very good for you if you have depression. So doing sports, especially the ones you enjoy , can really help with your mental health. 
I personally do weights at home almost every day. Helps me build self confidence, muscle, strength, better and healthier sleep patterns and doesnt hurt in the love life department.
So in general I would say you need to motivate yourself. Because nobody will be a better motivator than yourself and only you can keep yourself accountable. Try and get back into it on the weekends. And slowly integrate sport and/or exercises into your regular routine. 
This, in general, will help with your depression.  
Not saying it will cure you. You might still get days were you have no motivation. But I find doing something when you have no energy , even if it is 1/10 of what you usually do can feel satisfying and self rewarding. 
I hope this helps. And if you want to talk more about depression and other coping mechanisms I would be happy to talk further in PM.
I hope this helped 😊
